name: Wrecking Yard
design_intent:
WRECKING YARD — the MOVING-HAZARD level (v1_moving_hazard.md §3, v1_level_circuit.md §L-6, build order #8/LAST). A smoggy industrial scrapyard: three islands over ONE full-width lethal void (the flagship shape) with TWO swinging PENDULUM WRECKING BALLS, one over EACH crossing gap (a two-rhythm map, §3). Kill identity = knock rivals OFF an island / let a ball FLING them into the bottom void -> off the screen. Kill-shape class = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%; uncredited self-falls judged RELATIVE to flagship ~44%, per docs/specs/v2a_kill_shape_void_floor_addendum.md §3), NOT the central_pit K1 edge/pit ratio.

WHY TWO HAZARDS (v2 change; the single-ball v1 was validated in-engine and FAILED WY1's void-funnel target): a single pendulum over ONE of the two gaps produced only ~1.2 ball-contacts/stage and just 1/35 void deaths were hazard-assisted (~3% vs the >= 15% target) — because half the arena's crossings happen at the OTHER (un-hazarded) gap, and a single ball near the left bound flung mistimed crossers off the near LEFT side rather than into the void. Per §3's explicit lever ('if < 15%, the arm is not overhanging the crossing lane enough — move it INTO the lane (geometry), never buff the shove') and §3's blessed 'two-rhythm map', v2 puts a ball over BOTH gaps (offset phase 0.0 / 0.5 = anti-phase, so the two crossing lanes alternate their danger beat) and dips each ball DEEPER into its crossing corridor (arm 700 / radius 100 -> ball center dips to y1000, bottom edge y1100 = ~20px BELOW island-top height, dead over the void gap) so a mistimed crossing at ANY altitude is caught and flung, biasing contacts to the low, gap-centered part of the arc (over the void) rather than the high apex (over an island). This is GEOMETRY + a second additive kinematic prop only — NO Tuning/lethality/feel constant touched (fence per v1_moving_hazard.md §6).

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT FROM the 10 prior shipped/planned levels: this is the ONLY level with MOVING PARTS. islands_void is a bare archipelago; bumper_gauntlet studs the open space with STATIC ELASTIC reflectors (tier=='bumper', restitution 0.86, direction depends on YOUR approach); drop_chamber is an enclosed drum. Wrecking Yard's hazards are KINEMATIC DIRECTIONAL SHOVERS (MovingHazard, v1_moving_hazard.md §1): each SHOVES a contacted player along the ARM'S motion direction (fling you the way it swings, toward the void) — NEVER reflects your velocity, NEVER applies hitstun, NEVER kills. Two anti-phase balls add a RHYTHM/TIMING layer ON TOP of the flagship's flight-required crossings: cross a gap on that ball's CLEAR BEAT (it hangs ~0.8s at each apex, up high and clear of the lane), or get whipped into the void when the arm sweeps down through crossing altitude. One-sentence C3 read: 'cross the pit when the wrecking ball is clear, or time a rival's crossing so the ball flings THEM in.' The balls are the delivery mechanism; the VOID is the killer.

ENGINE PRIMITIVE (already built + committed — fence held): the 'moving_hazard' JSON object type (LevelLoader._build_moving_hazard) constructs a MovingHazard Area2D on its own collision layer (layer 5, distinct from the instakill LAYER_HAZARDS layer 4), sensing players only. Its contact path is Player.receive_shove(dir, rel, self): push = clampf(rel * soft_bump_scale 0.5, soft_bump_min 250, soft_bump_max 700) along the arm's motion direction — the EXACT soft-bump band, reused read-only. NO hitstun/_stun_timer/sting/damage_level, and it NEVER sets/overwrites last_attacker (so a resulting ring-out resolves through the existing 6.0s kill_credit_window_ringout fallback: credited to a player who tagged the victim, else an UNCREDITED self-fall). Motion is a deterministic phase clock (smootherstep swings + a flat DWELL at each apex = the readable clear beat), so the danger is self-telegraphing: an apex graze (arm vel ~0) barely nudges; a full-swing clip (arm tip ~3600px/s) clamps to the 700 ceiling. The shove is recoverable-with-fuel by construction (max 700px/s, full control retained).

GEOMETRY: three wide flat islands over ONE full-width lethal void (flagship 680px spacing): A trampoline x0..900 top1080 / B bubblegum x1580..2480 top1080 / C trampoline x3160..4060 top1080, separated by 680px void gaps. ONE elevated spring throne (x3640..4020 top560, 520px above the islands) sits over island C's outer-right as a boost-only prize, kept CLEAR of the ball arcs. TWO pendulum wrecking balls: HAZ1 anchored at pivot (1240,300) over the A<->B gap, HAZ2 at pivot (2820,300) over the B<->C gap, both arm_len 700, arc_deg 150, period_s 3.4, radius 100, dwell_frac 0.24; HAZ1 phase 0.0, HAZ2 phase 0.5 (anti-phase two-rhythm). Each ball hangs at its apexes at ~(pivot.x +/- 676, 481) — up HIGH (~600px above the islands) and clear of the lane (the safe clear beat) — and at the bottom of the swing its center is at (pivot.x, 1000), body spanning x(pivot.x-100..+100) (entirely INSIDE the 680px gap, never over an island: at an island edge the arm has already risen to y~912, ball bottom ~1012, clearing the island top by ~68px) and reaching DOWN to y1100 (below island-top crossing altitude, dead over the void) — so a mistimed crossing at ANY altitude through the gap center is clipped and flung out over the void. The two balls' reaches (max x1916 for HAZ1, min x2144 for HAZ2) leave a ~230px clear corridor over island B's center (x1916..2144) — the safe climb lane. Bounds -610..4670 keep the outer island edges (x0/x4060) 610px inside the side blast lines; the bottom bound y1878 leaves 670px of recovery sky under the islands (>= 650, Rule D). Top bound -2090 = derived (spring-throne top 560 minus self_super_rise 2450 + 200 clearance) so a straight-up self-super arcs back and top kills stay rare (this is NOT the dual_blast level).

HAZARD PLACEMENT RULE (v1_moving_hazard §3, hard): each ball's danger-arc overhangs its CROSSING LANE (mid-gap, over the void) so a mistimed crossing is flung INTO the void; but the apexes park each ball UP HIGH and to the SIDES (over the island interiors at y481), NOT parked so that standing-still is the only safe state (idle_hunt still applies; the balls create motion/timing pressure, they do not reward turtling). Neither is stacked over the deepest dead-center void with no runway: each gap has islands ~340px to each side, and the swing direction flings the victim laterally over 670px of recovery sky — a survivable-with-fuel recovery gamble, not an instant kill. Anti-phase (0.0/0.5) means when one gap's ball is at gap-center (danger) the other's is at its apex (clear), so there is ALWAYS one crossable gap — the map is never fully locked.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270px / bubblegum 180 / spring apex 480; air_drift_max 340px/s, gravity 1600 => zero-boost horizontal reach ~395px off a trampoline / ~320px off bubblegum / ~527px off a spring (the MAX possible drift); normal_boost_max 760px/s crosses a 680px gap in ~0.9-1.0s @ ~26 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super_boost_impulse 2800 clears everything but dumps the tank):
- GAP A<->B (island edges x900..x1580 = 680px over void, HAZ1's lane): > 527 (max spring drift; no spring sits at gap height) and >> 395 (trampoline drift off island A). NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. HAZ1 makes the TIMING load-bearing: launch just AFTER the ball passes gap-center (as it swings up to an apex) and you clear the lane during its ~0.8s+ apex dwell; launch as it is about to sweep down and it whips through your crossing altitude and flings you out over the void. Verb: FLY (+ TIME). (Rule A.)
- GAP B<->C (island edges x2480..x3160 = 680px over void, HAZ2's lane): > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. HAZ2 (anti-phase) times this crossing on the opposite beat. Verb: FLY (+ TIME).
- CLIMB to the spring throne (top560, over island C's right): 520px above the island tops (1080). Spring apex 480 does not exist at island level (islands are trampoline/bubblegum); a trampoline apex 270 from C reaches only y810 (-> 270px short), and an under-shot climb toward the throne drops toward the void gap. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY (+ SUPER earns the throne fast).
- RECOVER after a ball shove: the shove adds <= 700px/s with NO hitstun (full control retained) along the swing direction, and the drop from an island bottom (1192-1208) to the bottom blast line (y1878) is 670-686px of open sky over the void (>= 650, Rule D) -> a healthy fuelled shoved player boosts back to an island (the recovery gamble). A near-edge shove + starved/damaged victim rings out. Verb: FLY. (Rule D / C5.)
- The wrecking balls do NOT create a bounce path across a gap: they are shovers, not stepping stones; a zero-boost bounce-hop (at most ~395px of trampoline drift, and FALLING) never completes the 680px crossing, and a ball clip only ADDS speed toward the void, never a controlled crossing. A body reaches the far island ONLY by BOOSTING; the balls just time/reshape that boosted line. Every required crossing (680px) exceeds even a spring bounce's 527px reach and the throne sits > 480px above the islands, so NO route across or up the arena exists without the jetpack. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.

SUCCESS CRITERIA (void_is_floor class, v1_moving_hazard §3): WY1 — the hazards funnel kills: >= 12 four-bot stages, credited off-screen kills >= 88% (K1'a) AND >= 15% of void deaths within ~1.5s of a hazard contact (round_stats kills[].hazard_assisted). WY2 — hazards SHOVE, don't kill, clean credit: a MovingHazard never appears as a killer id; a hazard-shove of an un-tagged victim into the void is an uncredited self-fall (killer=-1), else credited to the last player attacker within the 6.0s window. WY3 — flight-required (>= 9/10): fuel-pinned direction-hold from an island does NOT cross a 680px gap (falls into the void); a real crossing logs >= 1 boost activation. WY-NOHITSTUN — a shoved player retains control (steering again next frame; no knockback jetstream). WY-DODGE — a crossing on the clear-beat apex makes the 680px crossing safely >= 8/10. WY-RECOVERY — a mid-island healthy full-fuel bot shoved outward boosts back >= 8/10. VOID READS AS DEATH via the pit_void_rendering treatment (dark bottomless gradient + receding scrap/dirt canyon walls + under-lip AO + matte hazard-red rim/chevrons along y1260 + falling motes). Smoggy grey-brown open_sky (clouds off) reads as an industrial yard, no cheer.
